slides.title: Moyale fighting: thousands cross into Kenya
slides.body: Update with new Kenya Red Cross figures

slides.title: Ethiopians have fled into Kenya
slides.body: according to humanitarian officials quoted by TRT World and Anadolu.

slides.title: people in six temporary camps
slides.body: in Moyale, Kenya, the Kenya Red Cross said. About 4,000 more stay with relatives and host families.

slides.title: deaths reported by Friday
slides.body: Officials feared more than a dozen may have been killed as fighting continued.

slides.title: Food, water and toilets urgently needed
slides.body: The Kenya Red Cross appealed for food, water and sanitation to prevent diarrhoeal disease.

slides.title: A dispute over a regional flag
slides.body: Fighting began Oct 21 over a Somali Region flag raised in an Oromia-administered area, reports say.

slides.title: Protect civilians. Talk, don't fight.
slides.body: Follow for sourced updates from across Ethiopia.

source: Source: TRT World / Anadolu, Kenya Red Cross · Oct 24, 2026
